import APPTReview.FixedLocalLimit
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- Continuity uses the actual partial transpose, a permutation of matrix entries. -/
theorem continuous_partialTranspose : Continuous
    (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ → Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose
  fun_prop

/-- An arbitrary (not finite or sampled) intersection of physical unitary tests is closed. -/
theorem isClosed_absolutelyPPT : IsClosed
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} := by
  have he : {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} =
      ⋂ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup (a × b) ℂ,
        {A | (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose ((U : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)*A*
          (U : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)ᴴ)).PosSemidef} := by
    ext A; simp [APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT]
  rw [he]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro U
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_is_closed.preimage
    (continuous_partialTranspose.comp (by fun_prop))

theorem isClosed_density : IsClosed
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A} := by
  exact Matrix.posSemidef_is_closed.inter (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_const)

theorem continuous_quantum_purity : Continuous
    (APPT.Quantum.purity : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ → ℝ) := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity
  fun_prop

/-- Hermitian purity is the sum of squared norms of the actual matrix entries. -/
theorem hermitian_purity_entry_squares {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity A = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j‖^2 := by
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hs : A j i=star (A i j) := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M => M j i) hA.eq
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using he.symm
  rw [hs, Complex.sq_norm]
  simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.normSq_apply]

/-- Trace-one positivity bounds every complex entry, with no spectral ansatz. -/
theorem density_entry_norm_le_one {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (i j : a × b) : ‖A i j‖≤1 := by
  have he := hermitian_purity_entry_squares hρ.1.isHermitian
  have hfirst : ‖A i j‖^2≤∑ k, ‖A i k‖^2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖A i k‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hsecond : (∑ k, ‖A i k‖^2)≤∑ l, ∑ k, ‖A l k‖^2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖A l k‖)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hu := (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2
  rw [he] at hu
  have hn := norm_nonneg (A i j)
  nlinarith

/-- The physical density-matrix set is compact in the entrywise finite-dimensional topology. -/
theorem isCompact_density : IsCompact
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A} := by
  have hc : IsCompact {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ |
      ∀ i j, A i j ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1} :=
    isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ => isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ => isCompact_closedBall 0 1))
  apply hc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_density
  intro A hA i j
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using density_entry_norm_le_one hA i j

/-- Compactness retains both positivity and all global-unitary PPT constraints. -/
theorem isCompact_density_appt : IsCompact
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A} :=
  isCompact_density.inter_right isClosed_absolutelyPPT

end APPTReview

import StateTopology

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- Exact strong-convexity identity in one complex coordinate. -/
theorem complex_norm_mix_square (z w : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖t • z+(1-t) • w‖^2 =
      t*‖z‖^2+(1-t)*‖w‖^2-t*(1-t)*‖z-w‖^2 := by
  simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.smul_re, Complex.smul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- Purity is a strictly positive quadratic form on nonzero Hermitian matrices. -/
theorem hermitian_purity_nonneg {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    0≤APPT.Quantum.purity A := by
  rw [hermitian_purity_entry_squares hA]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))

theorem hermitian_purity_eq_zero_iff {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity A=0 ↔ A=0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have he := hermitian_purity_entry_squares hA
    rw [hp] at he
    have hrows := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))).mp he.symm
    ext i j
    have hrow := hrows i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hentry := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)).mp hrow j (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hn : ‖A i j‖=0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (A i j)]
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp hn
  · intro h; subst A; simp [APPT.Quantum.purity]

/-- Strong convexity of actual quantum purity, with its exact Hilbert--Schmidt deficit. -/
theorem purity_mixture_identity {A B : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (t • A+(1-t) • B) =
      t*APPT.Quantum.purity A+(1-t)*APPT.Quantum.purity B-
        t*(1-t)*APPT.Quantum.purity (A-B) := by
  have hm : (t • A+(1-t) • B).IsHermitian :=
    (hA.smul (show IsSelfAdjoint t by rfl)).add
      (hB.smul (show IsSelfAdjoint (1-t) by rfl))
  rw [hermitian_purity_entry_squares hm, hermitian_purity_entry_squares hA,
    hermitian_purity_entry_squares hB, hermitian_purity_entry_squares (hA.sub hB)]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply]
  simp_rw [complex_norm_mix_square]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

/-- No proper mixture of distinct density matrices can maximize purity over a set
that also contains both endpoints. No convexity or spectrum premise is hidden. -/
theorem purity_proper_mixture_lt {A B : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (hne : A≠B)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht1 : t<1) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (t • A+(1-t) • B) <
      t*APPT.Quantum.purity A+(1-t)*APPT.Quantum.purity B := by
  rw [purity_mixture_identity hA hB]
  have hp : 0<APPT.Quantum.purity (A-B) := by
    have hn := hermitian_purity_nonneg (hA.sub hB)
    have hz : APPT.Quantum.purity (A-B)≠0 := by
      intro hz; exact hne (sub_eq_zero.mp ((hermitian_purity_eq_zero_iff (hA.sub hB)).mp hz))
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hn (Ne.symm hz)
  have hh := mul_pos (mul_pos ht (by linarith : 0<1-t)) hp
  linarith

end APPTReview

import PurityGeometry

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder Topology
open Matrix Filter
namespace APPTReview

/-- The original matrix-valued feasible set, not a spectral outer relaxation. -/
def apptStates (m n : ℕ) : Set (Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ) :=
  {A | APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A}

theorem apptStates_nonempty {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    (apptStates m n).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,_,_⟩ := exists_appt_fixed_local_lower hm hmn
  exact ⟨A,hd,ha⟩

theorem isCompact_apptStates (m n : ℕ) : IsCompact (apptStates m n) :=
  isCompact_density_appt

/-- Every finite-dimensional physical APPT purity problem has a maximizing state. -/
theorem exists_appt_purity_maximizer {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
      APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧
      ∀ B : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
        APPT.Quantum.IsDensity B → APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT B →
        APPT.Quantum.purity B≤APPT.Quantum.purity A := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hmax⟩ := (isCompact_apptStates m n).exists_isMaxOn
    (apptStates_nonempty hm hmn) continuous_quantum_purity.continuousOn
  exact ⟨A,hA.1,hA.2,fun B hd ha => hmax ⟨hd,ha⟩⟩

/-- The previously defined physical supremum is an attained greatest value,
in every dimension 2<=m<=n, not just eventually along an asymptotic regime. -/
theorem appt_purity_sup_isGreatest {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    IsGreatest (apptPurityValues m n) (apptPuritySup m n) := by
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,hmax⟩ := exists_appt_purity_maximizer hm hmn
  have hmem : APPT.Quantum.purity A∈apptPurityValues m n := ⟨A,hd,ha,rfl⟩
  have hb := (appt_purity_values_nonempty_bounded hm hmn).2
  have hupper (x : ℝ) (hx : x∈apptPurityValues m n) : x≤APPT.Quantum.purity A := by
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hmax B hB hp
  have he : apptPuritySup m n=APPT.Quantum.purity A :=
    le_antisymm (csSup_le ⟨_,hmem⟩ hupper) (le_csSup hb hmem)
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨hmem,hupper⟩

theorem exists_appt_purity_eq_sup {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
      APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧
      APPT.Quantum.purity A=apptPuritySup m n := by
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,he⟩ := (appt_purity_sup_isGreatest hm hmn).1
  exact ⟨A,hd,ha,he.symm⟩

/-- Attainment plus strict convexity excludes every nontrivial feasible mixture,
without asserting uniqueness of the maximizer. -/
theorem appt_maximizer_not_proper_mixture {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A B : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A∈apptStates m n) (hB : B∈apptStates m n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht1 : t<1)
    (hmax : APPT.Quantum.purity (t • A+(1-t) • B)=apptPuritySup m n) : A=B := by
  by_contra hne
  have hstrict := purity_proper_mixture_lt hA.1.1.isHermitian hB.1.1.isHermitian hne ht ht1
  have hu := (appt_purity_sup_isGreatest hm hmn).2
  have ha := hu (show APPT.Quantum.purity A∈apptPurityValues m n from ⟨A,hA.1,hA.2,rfl⟩)
  have hb := hu (show APPT.Quantum.purity B∈apptPurityValues m n from ⟨B,hB.1,hB.2,rfl⟩)
  have ha' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha ht.le
  have hb' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by linarith : 0≤1-t)
  rw [hmax] at hstrict
  nlinarith

end APPTReview

import MaximumExistence
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Basic

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- Positivity, trace one, and APPT are preserved by actual convex combinations. -/
theorem density_convex_combination {A B : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (hB : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity B)
    {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0≤s) (ht : 0≤t) (hst : s+t=1) :
    APPT.Quantum.IsDensity (s • A+t • B) := by
  refine ⟨(hA.1.smul hs).add (hB.1.smul ht),?_⟩
  simp only [Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_smul, hA.2, hB.2, Complex.real_smul, mul_one]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_add, hst, Complex.ofReal_one]

theorem appt_nonnegative_combination {A B : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hA : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A) (hB : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT B)
    {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0≤s) (ht : 0≤t) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT (s • A+t • B) := by
  intro U
  have hp := ((hA U).smul hs).add ((hB U).smul ht)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_add,Matrix.add_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul] using hp

theorem convex_apptStates (m n : ℕ) : Convex ℝ (apptStates m n) := by
  intro A hA B hB s t hs ht hst
  exact ⟨density_convex_combination hA.1 hB.1 hs ht hst,
    appt_nonnegative_combination hA.2 hB.2 hs ht⟩

/-- Exact quantitative obstruction to a near-maximizer being a widely separated mixture.
The right side is the actual optimality gap; the left side is squared Hilbert--Schmidt distance. -/
theorem appt_mixture_gap_controls_distance {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A B : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A∈apptStates m n) (hB : B∈apptStates m n)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0≤t) (ht1 : t≤1) :
    t*(1-t)*APPT.Quantum.purity (A-B) ≤
      apptPuritySup m n-APPT.Quantum.purity (t • A+(1-t) • B) := by
  rw [purity_mixture_identity hA.1.1.isHermitian hB.1.1.isHermitian]
  have hu := (appt_purity_sup_isGreatest hm hmn).2
  have ha := hu (show APPT.Quantum.purity A∈apptPurityValues m n from ⟨A,hA.1,hA.2,rfl⟩)
  have hb := hu (show APPT.Quantum.purity B∈apptPurityValues m n from ⟨B,hB.1,hB.2,rfl⟩)
  have ha' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha ht
  have hb' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by linarith : 0≤1-t)
  nlinarith

/-- For a midpoint, the exact factor is four, with no dimension-dependent loss. -/
theorem appt_midpoint_distance_bound {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A B : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : A∈apptStates m n) (hB : B∈apptStates m n) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A i j-B i j‖^2) ≤
      4*(apptPuritySup m n-APPT.Quantum.purity ((1/2:ℝ) • A+(1/2:ℝ) • B)) := by
  have h := appt_mixture_gap_controls_distance hm hmn hA hB
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)≤1)
  norm_num at h
  rw [hermitian_purity_entry_squares (hA.1.1.isHermitian.sub hB.1.1.isHermitian)] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_apply] using (show (∑ i,∑ j, ‖(A-B) i j‖^2)≤
    4*(apptPuritySup m n-APPT.Quantum.purity ((1/2:ℝ) • A+(1/2:ℝ) • B)) by linarith)

end APPTReview

import MaximumExistence
import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder Topology
open Matrix Filter
namespace APPTReview

/-- The actual set of maximizing matrices; this definition does not choose a spectrum. -/
def apptMaximizers (m n : ℕ) : Set (Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ) :=
  {A | A∈apptStates m n ∧ APPT.Quantum.purity A=apptPuritySup m n}

theorem isCompact_apptMaximizers (m n : ℕ) : IsCompact (apptMaximizers m n) :=
  (isCompact_apptStates m n).inter_right (isClosed_eq continuous_quantum_purity continuous_const)

theorem apptMaximizers_nonempty {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    (apptMaximizers m n).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,he⟩ := exists_appt_purity_eq_sup hm hmn
  exact ⟨A,⟨hd,ha⟩,he⟩

/-- Any sequence of nearly maximizing physical states has a convergent subsequence
whose limit is a genuine maximizing state. Dimensions are fixed in this theorem. -/
theorem appt_near_maximizers_subsequence {m n : ℕ}
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ k, A k∈apptStates m n)
    (hp : Tendsto (fun k => APPT.Quantum.purity (A k)) atTop (𝓝 (apptPuritySup m n))) :
    ∃ B∈apptMaximizers m n, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (A ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  letI : FirstCountableTopology (Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (FirstCountableTopology ((Fin m × Fin n) → (Fin m × Fin n) → ℂ))
  obtain ⟨B,hB,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_apptStates m n).tendsto_subseq hA
  have hc := (continuous_quantum_purity.tendsto B).comp hlim
  have hv := hp.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have he : APPT.Quantum.purity B=apptPuritySup m n := tendsto_nhds_unique hc hv
  exact ⟨B,⟨hB,he⟩,φ,hφ,hlim⟩

/-- A convergent sequence of genuine APPT densities remains physically feasible. -/
theorem appt_density_limit {m n : ℕ}
    (A : ℕ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ)
    {B : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hA : ∀ k, A k∈apptStates m n) (hlim : Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 B)) :
    B∈apptStates m n :=
  (isCompact_apptStates m n).isClosed.mem_of_tendsto hlim (Eventually.of_forall hA)

end APPTReview

import ConvexExtrema
import MaximizerLimits

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReviewCompactChecks

def imaginaryMatrix : Matrix (Fin 1 × Fin 1) (Fin 1 × Fin 1) ℂ := fun _ _ => Complex.I

theorem imaginary_purity : APPT.Quantum.purity imaginaryMatrix = -1 := by
  norm_num [APPT.Quantum.purity, imaginaryMatrix, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_one]

/-- The Frobenius interpretation would be false without Hermitian symmetry. -/
theorem imaginary_not_hermitian : ¬ imaginaryMatrix.IsHermitian := by
  intro h
  have he := APPTReview.hermitian_purity_nonneg h
  rw [imaginary_purity] at he
  norm_num at he

/-- PSD and all-unitary PPT alone do not imply the trace-one bound. -/
theorem identity_appt : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT
    (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) := by
  intro U
  simpa [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_mul_star_self] using
    (Matrix.PosSemidef.one : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ).PosSemidef)

theorem identity_purity_four : APPT.Quantum.purity
    (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ)=4 := by
  norm_num [APPT.Quantum.purity,Matrix.trace_one]

theorem identity_not_density : ¬ APPT.Quantum.IsDensity
    (1 : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ) := by
  intro h
  have hp := (APPTReview.density_purity_unit_interval h).2
  rw [identity_purity_four] at hp
  norm_num at hp

noncomputable def toyState (p : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin 2) (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ :=
  APPTReview.projectionPlateau 1 (APPTReview.setProjection {p})

theorem toyState_feasible (p : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : toyState p∈APPTReview.apptStates 2 2 := by
  exact ⟨APPTReview.projectionPlateau_isDensity (by decide) (by decide) 1 _
      (APPTReview.setProjection_hermitian _) (APPTReview.setProjection_sq _)
      (by simp [APPTReview.setProjection_trace]),
    APPTReview.projectionPlateau_absolutelyPPT (by decide) (by decide) 1 _
      (APPTReview.setProjection_hermitian _) (APPTReview.setProjection_sq _)⟩

theorem toyState_distinct : toyState (0,0) ≠ toyState (0,1) := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun A => A (0,0) (0,0)) h
  norm_num [toyState, APPTReview.projectionPlateau, APPTReview.plateauDenominator,
    APPTReview.setProjection,Matrix.diagonal,Matrix.one_apply,Complex.real_smul] at he

/-- Purity is strictly convex, not affine, even on two physical APPT states. -/
theorem toyState_midpoint_strict :
    APPT.Quantum.purity ((1/2:ℝ) • toyState (0,0)+(1/2:ℝ) • toyState (0,1)) <
      (1/2:ℝ)*APPT.Quantum.purity (toyState (0,0))+
      (1/2:ℝ)*APPT.Quantum.purity (toyState (0,1)) := by
  simpa only [show (1:ℝ)-1/2=1/2 by norm_num] using APPTReview.purity_proper_mixture_lt
    (toyState_feasible (0,0)).1.1.isHermitian (toyState_feasible (0,1)).1.1.isHermitian
    toyState_distinct (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2) (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)<1)

end APPTReviewCompactChecks

import StateTopology

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview
variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

/-- The entry-pair permutation implementing partial transposition in a trace-square sum. -/
def transposePairEquiv : ((a × b) × (a × b)) ≃ ((a × b) × (a × b)) where
  toFun p := ((p.2.1,p.1.2),(p.1.1,p.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.2.1,p.1.2),(p.1.1,p.2.2))
  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨i,x⟩,⟨j,y⟩⟩; rfl
  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨i,x⟩,⟨j,y⟩⟩; rfl

/-- Partial transposition preserves the actual trace-square expression. -/
theorem partialTranspose_purity (A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose A)=APPT.Quantum.purity A := by
  let f : ((a × b) × (a × b)) → ℝ := fun p => (A p.1 p.2*A p.2 p.1).re
  have he := (transposePairEquiv (a:=a) (b:=b)).sum_comp f
  simpa [APPT.Quantum.purity,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,
    Complex.re_sum,APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose,transposePairEquiv,f,Fintype.sum_prod_type] using he

/-- Transfer a proved bound on the actual ordered eigenvalues into matrix positivity. -/
theorem identity_sub_smul_posSemidef_of_spectral_cap
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ)
    (hcap : ∀ i, c*hA.eigenvalues₀ i≤1) :
    (1-c • A).PosSemidef := by
  let d : a × b → ℂ := fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)
  have hbound (i : a × b) : c*hA.eigenvalues i≤1 := by
    let j := (spectralLabel (a × b)).symm i
    have he := eigenvalues_spectralLabel hA j
    simp only [j,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
    rw [he]
    exact hcap j
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (1:ℂ)-(c:ℂ)*d i)).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    change (0:ℂ)≤1-(c:ℂ)*(hA.eigenvalues i : ℂ)
    exact_mod_cast (sub_nonneg.mpr (hbound i))
  have he : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (1:ℂ)-(c:ℂ)*d i) =
      (1-c • Matrix.diagonal d : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i=j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply,Matrix.one_apply,hij,Complex.real_smul]
  rw [he] at hdiag
  have hp := hdiag.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
    (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)
  have hs := hA.spectral_theorem
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal,Function.comp_def] at hs
  simpa [d,Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,Matrix.smul_mul,
    ← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,Unitary.coe_mul_star_self,← hs] using hp

/-- An upper bound on a Hermitian trace-square gives a true operator upper bound. -/
theorem hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hp : APPT.Quantum.purity A≤1) : (1-A).PosSemidef := by
  have hs : (∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)^2)≤1 := by
    rwa [purity_eq_ordered_eigenvalues hA] at hp
  have hc (i) : (1:ℝ)*hA.eigenvalues₀ i≤1 := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j∈Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues₀ j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hb := hh.trans hs
    nlinarith
  simpa using identity_sub_smul_posSemidef_of_spectral_cap hA 1 hc

/-- The partial transpose of every physical density matrix is bounded above by I. -/
theorem density_partialTranspose_upper
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    (1-APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose A).PosSemidef := by
  apply hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one
    (APPT.Quantum.partialTranspose_isHermitian hρ.1.isHermitian)
  rw [partialTranspose_purity]
  exact (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2

/-- Complement-density sufficiency under EVERY global unitary, with no Schmidt assumption. -/
theorem one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT
    {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ} (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT (1-A) := by
  intro U
  have hp := density_partialTranspose_upper (APPT.Quantum.isDensity_unitaryConjugate hρ U)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Unitary.coe_mul_star_self] using hp

end APPTReview

variable {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]

noncomputable def complementDensity (A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ) :=
  (1/((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1)) • (1-A)

theorem complementDensity_isDensity
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity (complementDensity A) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ)<(Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1 := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  constructor
  · exact (hermitian_one_sub_posSemidef_of_purity_le_one hρ.1.isHermitian
      (density_purity_unit_interval hρ).2).smul (by positivity)
  · have ht : (1-A).trace=(((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1):ℂ) := by
      simp [Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2]
    simp only [complementDensity,Matrix.trace_smul,ht,Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    simp [ne_of_gt hc]

theorem complementDensity_absolutelyPPT
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT (complementDensity A) := by
  have hc : (0:ℝ)<(Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1 := sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  exact APPT.Quantum.absolutelyPPT_smul (one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT hρ) (by positivity)

/-- Exact physical second moment of the normalized complement. -/
theorem complementDensity_purity {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) :
    APPT.Quantum.purity (complementDensity A) =
      ((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-2+APPT.Quantum.purity A)/((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1)^2 := by
  have he : (1-A)*(1-A)=(1 : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ)-(2:ℝ) • A+A*A := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
    module
  unfold APPT.Quantum.purity complementDensity
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul,he]
  simp only [Matrix.trace_smul,Matrix.trace_add,Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2,
    Complex.smul_re,Complex.add_re,Complex.sub_re,Complex.one_re,Complex.natCast_re,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- Any trace-one PSD matrix below I/(D-1) is genuinely APPT.
This is a proved sufficiency implication, not an assumed spectral characterization. -/
theorem density_spectral_cap_absolutelyPPT
    (hD : 1<Fintype.card (a × b)) {A : Matrix (a × b) (a × b) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A)
    (hcap : (1-((Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1) • A).PosSemidef) :
    APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A := by
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card (a × b):ℝ)-1
  have hc : 0<c := by dsimp [c]; exact sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  have hQ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity (1-c • A) := by
    refine ⟨hcap,?_⟩
    simp [Matrix.trace_sub,Matrix.trace_smul,Matrix.trace_one,hρ.2,c,Complex.real_smul]
  have hp := APPT.Quantum.absolutelyPPT_smul (one_sub_density_absolutelyPPT hQ)
    (show (0:ℝ)≤1/c by positivity)
  have he : (1-(1-c • A))=c • A := by abel
  rw [he,smul_smul] at hp
  simpa [ne_of_gt hc] using hp

end APPTReview
